title: Factual applications / presentation and metric
slide_intent: Give informational content enough visual structure to remain readable and recognizable.
strategic_value: Light space, a red mark and a clear metric can connect DB’s presentation and performance communication.
demonstration: A white presentation title slide sits beside a punctuality infographic with a rail icon, partial gauge and change figure.
practical_value: Compare when a simple text hierarchy is sufficient and when a metric needs a graphic.

content_islands.name: Presentation cover
content_islands.spec: Keep the red mark, title and secondary details on a spacious white field.

content_islands.name: Metric panel
content_islands.spec: Pair the punctuality heading with the gauge, train icon and +3.4% example.

reference_purposes.Application: The two specimens apply the factual design range to a title slide and performance metric.
